create_batch_renderer: create a BatchRenderer instance with width, height, renderer type, and number of workers for parallel VSD computation
add_object_to_renderer: add an object with an obj_id and model path to the BatchRenderer models dictionary
run_vsd_errors: run VSD error computation across all image errors using multiprocessing workers and collect results
get_num_workers_used: get the number of workers to use based on image count versus model count threshold
init_renderers_for_workers: initialize worker folders and save renderer args and model paths as JSON for each worker
